title: UniFlow
tagline: Uniflow is a programmable payroll and treasury infrastructure built on Circle’s Arc stack.
description: Uniflow is a programmable payroll and treasury infrastructure built on Circle’s Arc stack that enables automated, multi-recipient USDC payouts across chains. It combines onchain treasury controls with Circle Wallets, Gateway, and Bridge Kit to deliver secure, policy-based global salary settlement and scalable financial operations.
